title: Could Dayot Upamecano have stopped Hitler from conquering France?
caption: Could Dayot Upamecano have stopped the 1940 invasion of France? Elite defending. What could possibly go wrong. 🛡️🇫🇷 #could #upamecano #football #defender #history #whatif #fyp

scenes.text: Could Dayot Upamecano have stopped Hitler from conquering France? {{ev}}We looked at the evidence. {{sci}}Scientifically. ||0.2|| {{long}}Mostly the highlights.

In defence: {{name}}Dayot Upamecano. {{best}}One of the best centre backs in the world right now. {{really}}Genuinely. {{h}}{1.86|One point eight six} metres of French international. {{calm}}Famous for his calm, completely error free defending. ||0.4|| {{wink}}Mostly.

In attack: {{name}}the German army, May {1940|nineteen forty}. {{men}}Around three million soldiers. {{tanks}}Roughly two and a half thousand tanks. {{mag}}France had built the Maginot Line. {{around}}So the Germans simply went around it. {{ard}}Through the Ardennes.

Phase one. {{t}}Space defending. {{space}}The Ardennes is a lot of space. {{loves}}Upamecano loves space. {{line}}He holds a perfect high line {{shift}}and shifts across the entire forest. {{none}}Not one tank gets through the half space.

Phase two. {{t}}The tackle. {{tank}}A tank weighs around twenty tonnes. {{upa}}Upamecano: around ninety kilograms. {{slide}}He goes in with a perfectly timed sliding tackle. ||0.3|| {{clean}}Clean. All ball. {{card}}The tank is booked for simulation.
Phase three. {{t}}The offside trap. {{step}}On his signal, the French defence steps up as one. {{off}}Three million soldiers. All offside. {{var}}The video review takes six weeks.

The verdict. {{q}}Could Dayot Upamecano have stopped the invasion? ||0.5|| {{yes}}Yes. ||0.4|| {{but}}With one small risk. {{risk}}At some point, under no pressure at all, he tries one simple pass. ||0.25|| {{oops}}And the entire German army walks past him. {{p1}}Chance he stops them: ninety nine percent. {{p2}}Chance of one famous easy mistake: ||0.25|| {{p3}}also ninety nine.
Could you imagine another scenario that we should do next? {{c}}Write it in the comments.
